artworks.title: Cour du Dragon (Dragon Court)
artworks.medium: albumen silver print
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow street with cobblestones, lined by tall buildings on either side. Carts and wares are on the left, while the right side has open doorways and architectural details. The street leads into the distance where a curved building with windows is visible, marking the horizon. The scene has a sepia tone, creating a vintage atmosphere with a limited palette of browns and tans. The lighting is soft, highlighting the textures of the buildings and cobblestones. The urban landscape includes signs that contribute to its historical character.

artworks.title: St. Étienne du Mont, rue de la Montagne Sainte Geneviève (St. Étienne du Mont, Montagne Sainte Geneviève Street)
artworks.medium: albumen silver print

artworks.title: Allée, Château de Grand-Vaux, Savigny-sur-Orge, the Family Home of Vigier
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined avenue with a central pavilion-like structure in the distance. Tall trees line the road symmetrically, creating an archway overhead. The horizon is low, with the structure at the vanishing point. The photo is in sepia tone, emphasizing the depth and shadow play among the trees and road. The composition directs focus towards the distant structure.

artworks.title: Diogenes in His Tub with Alexander and His Generals
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of men surrounding a person lying inside a large container, partially covered with a cloth. The person inside the container has a muscular build, a beard, and short hair, gesturing with one hand. The other men are standing upright, dressed in draped garments and helmets. Some of their faces are partially obscured. In the foreground, there is a tree and a stone block with an inscription. The background includes buildings, trees, and figures riding horses.

artworks.title: Grotesque with Strapwork in the Form of a Cartouche
artworks.artist: Johannes van Doetechum the Elder, and Lucas van Doetechum, after Cornelis Floris II
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a highly detailed ornamental design filled with mythological and symbolic motifs. The composition includes a central architectural structure, possibly a monument or an altar, flanked by various figures and decorative elements. The structure features a semi-circular arch adorned with fruits, leaves, and a central lion's head crest. Surrounding the structure are several human-like figures and fantastical creatures resembling satyrs and lions. Two female statues stand on either side of the centerpiece holding bouquets or cornucopias filled with fruit. The design is monochromatic with rich shadows and detailed textures. The phrase "Houdt den cock in eeren" is inscribed prominently in the central section.

artworks.title: Venus Honored by the Nymphs
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in a detailed, classical-inspired scene. The central figure is seated with their legs crossed against a decorative structure. They are draped in cloth around the waist, revealing a bare torso, with delicate facial features and wavy, tightly curled hair. Surrounding figures are in dynamic poses, some holding ornate plates with fruit, and one airborne figure carrying a basket. A child or cherubic figure stands beside the central figure, with one hand on a small pedestal. All figures have classical features and wavy hairstyles. The backdrop suggests an architectural setting with grand columns, drapery, and a hint of a classical building, creating depth and richness in the scene.

artworks.title: Monstrous Craws, at a New Coalition Feast
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, and aquatint, with publisher's hand coloring in watercolor, on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures with elongated necks and large sacks under their chins, seated around a bowl filled with coins. They are eating from the bowl using oval-shaped spoons, wearing elaborate clothing. The central figure wears a feathered hat or headdress and a red cloak. The composition suggests gluttony and greed, emphasized by overflowing coins and bulging sacks. The setting appears to be an interior space, with a stone archway in the background.

artworks.title: a) Studies of Figures and a Hand (recto); b) Studies of a Bull (verso)
artworks.medium:
a) red chalk on laid paper
b) red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a robed figure and a child in a rough, sketchy style. The image features a lightly drawn scene with figures rendered in a reddish-brown chalk or pencil. On the left is a sketch of a child or small figure seated or positioned on some sort of pedestal or structure. The figure seems slightly blurred into the lines. To the right is a more prominent figure, possibly an adult, with draped clothing that creates flowing, curved lines. The drawing is characterized by its unfinished, dynamic nature.

artworks.title: Study for the Sibyl of the Casa Budrioli
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a partial view of two figures: a woman and a child. The woman is seated, facing slightly towards the child, who appears to be standing close to her and reaching towards her. The woman's facial features are delicately drawn, with soft lines hinting at a gentle expression, and her hair is styled with an elegant, loose arrangement adorned with curls. She wears a flowing garment with visible drapery and bow-like details near the breast area. The child has curly hair and reaches towards the woman, enhancing the sense of interaction. No jewelry or objects are visible within the sketch. The background is largely undefined, focusing attention on the figures themselves, with the aged quality of the paper adding texture to the composition. A small emblem appears on the lower right corner of the paper, while another mark is visible in the lower-left area.

artworks.title: A Seated Man
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a person's seated three-quarter view. The subject is casually posed with one arm on the chair's back and the other arm bent. The person is drawn in profile, featuring lightly sketched facial characteristics like a nose and lips. The hair is styled upwards, potentially in a bun or elaborate updo. The individual is wearing a flowing garment, perhaps a robe or dress, reaching down to the feet, with pencil markings indicating folds and creases. The person is depicted wearing pointed shoes. No visible accessories or objects are depicted. The background is minimalistic, with textured shading highlighting the figure, lacking distinctive elements or scenery.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait with an Injured Foot
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint printed in brown
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person lying on a bed, holding a sheet of paper. The person is reclined with their upper body slightly elevated against a cushion. They have curly hair and are wearing a loose-fitting cap, long-sleeved garment, pants, and fabric tied around the waist. The room contains a lamp on a small table, a jug, a plate, and other items in the background. The background is dark, creating a contrast with the illuminated area.

artworks.title: Bouquet of Roses
artworks.medium: lithograph (proof) on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white illustration of a bouquet of large flowers in a glass vase. The flowers have round, full petals with some leaves visible. Two smaller fallen flowers are below the vase. The illustration is in shades of black, white, and grey for depth. The main bouquet is slightly off-center towards the upper portion of the image, with the vase's base near the bottom center. The fallen flowers and a stem are at the lower left.

artworks.title: Gentle Critics (The Portfolio)
artworks.medium: watercolor over traces of graphite with gum arabic and white gouache on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals, with their upper bodies visible. The person on the left is a child standing and leaning over the lap of the seated individual on the right. The child has curly brown hair with a red ribbon and wears a brown dress with blue accents. The seated individual has long light brown hair, framed by a blue ribbon around the neck, and wears a long-sleeved pale dress with a pink skirt. They hold an open book together, with the adult supporting it on her lap while the child's hand rests on a page. The background includes a partially finished painting or blank canvas on an easel and draped fabric over a stool, creating an indoor setting. The lighting is soft, illuminating the figures and their interaction with the book.

artworks.title: Netley Abbey, Hampshire
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash over traces of graphite
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of an ancient Gothic structure, possibly a cathedral or abbey, with arches and pillars. The view is low within the structure, looking up towards the open space where the sky can be seen through broken windows and arches. Stone walls and arches obscure the horizon, but the sky is visible with light cloud cover. The brushstrokes are detailed, capturing patterns and textures of the stonework, with a color palette of browns, grays, and soft blues. Light and shadow emphasize details in the stonework and vegetation, with hints of greenery. Delicate touches of light colors suggest remnants of the structure's grandeur in the distance.

artworks.title: The Vow of Louis XIII (Louis XIII and His Wife, Anne of Austria, Entrusting the New Prince and the Crown to the Virgin)
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures. Two figures on the left have long wavy hair and wear ornate robes. One of them holds a crown with a baby in the center. A woman sits on the right on clouds. A small child stands next to her. The background features an arched architectural structure with detailed ceilings and columns.

artworks.title: Head of Frau Bauer
artworks.medium: drypoint with aquatint, printed in brown
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund

artworks.title: The Virgin Giving the Girdle to Saint Thomas, between Saints Francis and Catherine of Siena
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white gouache, on laid paper laid down on an old mount
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a celestial scene. The drawing features a central figure draped in flowing robes amidst a dynamic cloudscape filled with small figures resembling cherubs. Below this figure, two other figures gesture upwards in various poses. Their draped garments and expressive postures create a sense of movement and drama. The composition is detailed, with delicate lines and varying shades of brown, conveying a sense of depth and atmosphere.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait in Three-Quarter Figure
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé on wove paper

artworks.title: Pines on a Mountaintop at Night
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense, wooded landscape dominated by large coniferous trees. The horizon is low, almost obscured by the trees. Fine details and textured brushstrokes add depth to the trees and rocks. Closest to the viewer is rocky terrain with vegetation, leading to a dense array of trees. The color palette is primarily shades of gray and black, creating a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Trees with Tangled Roots
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint
artworks.creditLine: Gift of C. G. Boerner LLC, in honor of Rena Hoisington
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome etching depicting a forest scene. The observer is on the forest floor looking slightly upward at a cluster of large trees. The etching features intricate roots sprawling across the ground, with trees rising behind them. The horizon is obscured by foliage and tree trunks, creating a closed visual space. The style includes detailed lines and cross-hatching to depict textures of bark, leaves, and roots. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing line work and contrast. Additional trees are visible in the distance, blending into the shaded background to add depth to the composition.
